views.semantics: Each intersection asks: which shell devices and instrument targets in this area draw on this native product, and as what? A placement exists only where a manual entry's Product line names the product (coverage 'product' when it is the entry's product, 'with' when named after 'with'), or where a target's native_owners name it (coverage 'native-owner'). The houses row places the devices §16.1 names in each house a second time. The direction is always shell → product: the shell presents, the product owns the operation and its state. Empty means unassessed, never absent or impossible.

views.title: Stories · story × position (the six cells)
views.semantics: Each intersection asks: what does this story's cell at this position refer to? A row is one story of docs/experience, read by scripts/experience_map.py; its id is the story's row locator. A column is one of the six positions, which are also the six document tiers (O-I #710; STORY-PROFILE §1). A cell carries references, not a copy: p0 the Why line's citations (the owner's words, tier 0) or, for an earlier-form family, the sources it declares; p1 the row, with its act as need and its completion as outcome; p2 where it is carried, with capability_refs naming the rows of this matrix whose documentation.design_refs hold a manual unit the cell cites (extensions.ux.absent_units names a cited unit with no capability row yet; external_capability_refs names native candidates, never copied here); p3 the owning operation and agent as written, with the products it names (the native operation stays binding-required); p4 the starting world, port sources (the code is the p2 rows' own code_refs); p5 the declared grade, with the proof refs as test_refs and the CASES.md acceptance cases whose row names the story. Empty means the story source leaves that cell open (an earlier-form story names no starting world, and no place unless 'Where the earlier stories now happen' maps it); never complete or impossible. Placements are derived, agent-inference; a walk, a grade reached or the owner's EX is recorded only by its own evidence.
